education.extra: Achievements: Example Hackathon winner; Dean's List

bullets.text: Built a Python pipeline that cleans 200K survey records and trains a gradient-boosted classifier, cutting manual review time by 60%.
Wrote SQL reports and a small dashboard that the team uses every week.
Matched 300 students into study groups with a clustering model and a simple web form.
Ran 6 beginner workshops on pandas and SQL for 40+ students.
